scope: Founder current five-step prompt + prior system-wide failure Mirror Reviews + ML-023/024/026 + new fail-closed execution coding.
reason: Repeated evidence showed that narrative controls alone were not reliably preventing prompt/control drift, technical-check substitution, premature HOLDS/PASS claims, or isolated-incident reframing.

initial_coding_review.finding: V1 strengthened blocking but still relied too heavily on boolean self-certification.
initial_coding_review.correction: Upgraded to V2 ordered evidence-backed execution gate.

v2_controls: Exact Founder prompt text and SHA required; Python and GitHub source SHA must match.
Every required event must PASS and carry evidence.
Every explicit/inherited requirement must be represented in an evidence-backed requirement matrix.
Actual artifacts/outputs must receive evidence-backed semantic fidelity, output-type, and control-fidelity review.
Technical metadata checks cannot substitute for actual-work review.
Failed/rejected artifacts cannot be repackaged as compliant work without explicit Founder authorization.
Repeated failures trigger stabilization mode and cannot be reframed as isolated.
Founder-only status terms APPROVED/SAVED/CURRENT_CONTROLLED require explicit Founder directive.
Final status claims are blocked while any violation remains.
status_boundary: This PASS applies only to the execution-gate coding correction cycle. It does not convert the broader Legacy system-wide FAIL/OPEN status into PASS and does not itself modify the underlying model.
